domains.title: Company domains or URLs
domains.description: Company websites, one per line: a domain (example.de), a URL (https://www.example.at) or the Impressum URL itself. One output row per domain. Only rows with a register number or VAT ID are billed.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Domains processed in parallel. Each domain is fetched one page at a time (robots.txt, home page, Impressum).
